integrity: The continuum theorem is proved by an analytic mixed-derivative identity and circular-arc rearrangement. Finite code checks are supplementary only. An independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns fixed coefficient magnitudes and complex coefficient phases on the continuous two-torus for finite positive exponents. It does not classify unrestricted changes in amplitudes, finite cyclic sampling, or arbitrary Fourier supports.
title: A sharp phase-order transition for the four-character Fourier rectangle
